name: Interactive Large Iso-Surface Ray Tracing (DeMarle et al.)
definition: An out-of-core iso-surface ray tracing engine using a PC cluster to render volume data sets too large for single PC main memory. It uses a hierarchical grid acceleration structure and a three-level bricking approach with low memory overhead.
summary: This out-of-core engine renders massive volume datasets on PC clusters using a rectilinear hierarchical grid and image-order traversal to achieve interactive frame rates.
